method.capture: Two natural floor-one journeys; retain the last reached purchase/forge/fusion/memorywell before each checkpoint, after complete available balanced allocation. Every capture records its actual floor. A missing encounter is NOT_REACHED, never synthesized.
method.budget: Alternatives within EACH captured encounter begin with identical complete state and held gold. Each may spend at most the common fraction of that balance. Actual payments differ and unused budget stays in the player wallet. Different service captures are not same-state alternatives.
method.naturalPolicy: Expected-improvement equipment/shop choices; conservative weapon forge below +9; all safe low-rarity fusion; first enabled adventurous event; complete balanced finite talent priorities then power.
method.continuation: Exactly the next configured number of combat attempts, or first death. Keep chosen equipment; put newly earned points in power; open boxes; collect gold; use free rest; otherwise decline events and skip services. No further coins are spent.
method.fusion: Up to first eight unlocked, unequipped, non-loot materials of rarity below legendary and no higher than any target; shorten bundle to fit the common spend ceiling. No protected/high-rarity consumption.
method.rng: Buy/equip/reset do not draw RNG and all such branches assert equal first enemy and combat-opening RNG to keep-gold. Forge/fusion spend one real die; their paid branches assert the same face and first battle start, while keep-gold retains that RNG draw. Later kill timing, luck and routes may diverge; this is the full legal decision effect, not an isolated stat effect.
method.hash: Only runId is normalized in state fingerprints. No gameplay, log, reward or XP field is removed. The script plus seeds, policy and capture rule reproduces each initial state without shipping large save dumps.

limits: Fixed offline policies and two seeds are not human win rates or optimal choices.
A larger damage sum can merely mean more overkill; use turns, actual HP loss and death together.
The reported damageTaken is gross committed retaliation before subsequent healing, not opening HP minus ending HP.
New loot, level-up healing, later RNG and route effects remain part of the legal continuation; no outcome is attributed solely to one stat.
No balance, price, rarity, ID, save schema or production rule is changed by this script.
The 25% budget ceiling is an audit-only analysis constraint, not a production rule.
All 76 short windows have zero gross committed retaliation. Survival discrimination is saturated; six battles do not establish long-term survival superiority.
A drop in minimum HP can be the immediate equipment/respec capacity clipping, not combat injury.
